entries.title: Receive outstanding orders from one page
entries.description: Open Inventory > Receiving to find outstanding purchase order lines, search orders and receive deliveries. Orders appear by expected date, with late deliveries clearly marked.

entries.title: See fractional purchase quantities accurately
entries.description: Receiving, arrivals, returns, amendments, credit notes and invoice checks now show fractional quantities without rounding them to whole numbers.

entries.title: Adjust terms after accepting a quote
entries.description: You can now update the discount, deposit, delivery terms and delivery charge on accepted locked quotes. The price and specification remain locked.

entries.title: Read dashboard cards on smaller screens
entries.description: Scroll through scheduled jobs after the first two rows. Narrow Bay load cards show one readable gauge.

entries.title: Browse product tabs without an extra scrollbar
entries.description: The product tab bar no longer shows an unnecessary vertical scrollbar.

entries.title: Read gold text more easily in light mode
entries.description: Gold text and accents now use a darker shade to improve readability against light backgrounds.

entries.title: Access page actions directly
entries.description: Header actions stay visible as buttons while they fit beside the title. Single actions remain visible without opening a menu.

entries.title: Scan activity more easily
entries.description: Activity feeds now use consistent note bubbles with author labels and distinct icons for events. Links beneath notes are easier to select.

entries.title: Recognise people by their first names
entries.description: Everyday user labels now show first names. Full names remain available in user lists, user dropdowns and avatar hover labels.
